settings.title: Settings
settings.account.username_hint: Usernames can be changed by an admin.
settings.account.2fa_sub: A code from an authenticator app on every login.
settings.account.2fa_off_desc: Off · protect your account with a code
settings.account.2fa_step1: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or type the key by hand.
settings.account.2fa_step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows to finish.
settings.account.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
settings.account.recovery_note: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if you lose your phone. They are not shown again.
settings.account.2fa_disable_body: Enter your password to turn two-step login off.
settings.account.delete_body: This removes your account, projects you own and your comments from this server. Export your data first if you want a copy.
settings.account.last_admin: You are the last admin. Make someone else an admin first.
settings.account.password_sub: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
settings.appearance.sub: Theme and the manga motifs around the studio
settings.appearance.motion_desc: Turns off page-turns, slashes and speed lines
settings.appearance.textures_desc: Screentone and ink accents outside the editor
settings.language.reading_desc: Chapters open in the first available language
settings.language.reading_empty: No preference yet: chapters open in their original language.
settings.language.auto_translate_desc: For series whose creators allow it
settings.language.rtl: Right-to-left interface for Arabic and Hebrew
settings.reading.sub: Defaults for new series; each series remembers its own
settings.reading.filter_desc: Show only hand-drawn series in Explore
settings.reading.download: Auto-download new chapters of followed series
settings.reading.data_saver_desc: Lower resolution, no living-panel loops on mobile data
settings.notifications.sub: Choose what reaches you, and where
settings.notifications.note: Email uses the server’s SMTP. Push needs an installed app (PWA).
settings.notifications.note_no_email: Email needs SMTP set up by the admin. Push needs an installed app (PWA).
settings.a11y.sub: Motion, contrast, text and reading aids
settings.a11y.motion_desc: Follows your system setting; no page-turns, slashes, speed lines or glow pulses
settings.a11y.aloud_desc: Uses alt-text and dialogue, not OCR
settings.a11y.alt: Always show alt-text in guided view
settings.a11y.dyslexia_desc: Swaps the UI font; lettering inside pages is unchanged
settings.a11y.colour_desc: Status always shows an icon and a word as well
settings.world.sub: Share characters, templates and series on World
settings.world.title: World is optional and off by default
settings.world.body: When your admin links this server, you can choose a World name and submit your work for review. Nothing is shared until you submit it.
settings.world.off: This server is not linked to World.
settings.world.off_admin: This server is not linked to World. Link it from Admin → World when you are ready.
settings.world.local_only: Local only mode is on, so World is blocked on this server.
settings.world.soon: Connection settings arrive with the World module
settings.data.sub: Everything you made belongs to you
settings.data.export_desc: One archive: projects, pages, scripts, characters, LoRAs, packs and settings.
settings.data.no_quota: {host} sets no storage limit for your account.
settings.data.history_desc: Version history follows your admin’s retention settings; locked and branched pages are kept.
settings.data.cleared: Offline downloads cleared on this device
